results.title: Smart Sand, Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2024
results.snippet: Smart Sand's core customers are oil and gas exploration and production companies and oilfield service companies, according to its 10-K filings.

results.title: Smart Sand, Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2025
results.snippet: It mines Northern White sand used as proppant in hydraulic fracturing, and it offers in-basin transloading and SmartSystems wellsite proppant storage. Its FY2025 10-K says it also sells to diversified industrial and commercial customers.

results.title: Smart Sand, Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2023
results.snippet: Most sand is sold on spot or short-term terms. Its industrial products business began in late 2021 and remains a small share of sales.
